# Balsm Healthcare Platform

Balsm is a revolutionary open source healthcare platform built for healthcare professionals, patients, and developers. It is designed to be transparent, community-driven, and perfectly accessible to everyone.

## Project Details
- **Domain**: balsm.health
- **Contact Email**: info@balsm.health
- **Core Focus**: Open Source Healthcare, EMR/EHR, Patient/Provider Portal, Telemedicine.

## Core Features & Values
- **Built on Privacy**: We care about user privacy. Data is secure, encrypted, and never shared.
- **For Healthcare Professionals**: Streamlined practices with modern clinical tools designed by the community.
- **For Patients**: Taking control of personal health journeys via transparent scheduling and prescription management.
- **For Contributors (Open Source)**: All skills are welcome—from coding to medical advocacy.

## Target Audience
- Patients seeking transparent healthcare management.
- Doctors, nurses, and clinical staff seeking an open-source, flexible EHR/practice management system.
- Health tech developers and open-source contributors looking to build the future of medicine.

## Technology
- Next.js (React) modern web platform.
- Fully server-side rendered for maximum performance and accessibility.
- Deployed via Cloudflare for edge-network speed.
